scope: Seven review images only. No mapping, recipe changes, merge or deployment.

visual_review.review_status: complete: all seven pass visual QA; steak garlic correction independently re-reviewed
visual_review.method: Independently read the exact specification, viewed all seven originals at full 1536x1024 resolution, viewed the margarita reference, and compared BBQ, meatballs and pie against their previously accepted originals. No photo editing. Diagnostic enlargement of steak garnish was also inspected; original files were not modified. Reopened the final revised steak at full resolution and rechecked its count, garnish, framing and background.

global.style: Bright, sharp, true-to-life food on white vessels with thin slate-blue rims. No text, props, hands, steam, horizon lines or extra objects observed.
global.background: Visually flat and even, with short local contact shadows. Corner patch means differ by less than approximately 1.5 RGB levels within each image, supporting absence of a corner vignette. Small departures from literal target hex values are recorded below, but visually correct hue families.
global.framing: All seven vessels are wholly inside x=384..1152, the central half-width crop. Approximate manual visual bounds include the vessel but exclude its shadow.
global.limitations: Photographs cannot prove ingredient identity, exact physical sizes, lens focal length, tablespoon quantity or doneness temperature. Counts and appearance are judged visually.
